DBR is hiring an entry-level Python Developer I to build and support automations and AI-enabled tools that reduce manual effort and improve quality across the firm’s MEP engineering, design, and business operations. The role develops Python and PowerShell scripts, Power Automate workflows, and Revit automation, while supporting users and maintaining existing automations.
Consulting
Consumer Goods
Electronics
Consumer Electronics
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Develop, test, and maintain Python scripts and small applications that automate repetitive engineering, design, and administrative workflows (e.g., load and equipment schedules, calculation spreadsheets, report and file generation)
Build and maintain no-code/low-code automations using Microsoft Power Automate and related Microsoft 365 tools (SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Excel, Forms, Power Apps)
Create and support Autodesk Revit automation using pyRevit, Dynamo, and/or the Revit API to help MEP design teams with model QA/QC checks, sheet and view setup, parameter management, and data export
Assist in integrating AI capabilities—such as large language models and document/data extraction tools—into internal workflows, in line with the firm’s data security and responsible AI-use guidelines
Meet with engineers, designers, and project staff to understand manual processes and pain points, document requirements, and translate them into user stories and technical tasks
Use Azure DevOps for source control (Git), work item tracking, code reviews, and build/release pipelines
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives, and provide accurate estimates and status updates
Write clear documentation and user guides, train end users on new tools, and provide troubleshooting and support for deployed automations
Monitor, maintain, and improve existing automations to keep them reliable as software versions, templates, and firm standards change
Perform additional assignments as requested/needed

Required
Associate degree or higher in a technical field
0–2 years of related experience; internships, co-ops, and substantial academic or personal projects count toward this requirement
0–2 years of experience in software development, scripting, or automation, including internships, co-ops, or significant academic/personal projects
Hands-on experience writing Python and/or PowerShell scripts; a portfolio or code samples are welcome
Working knowledge of Python fundamentals, including data structures, functions, modules, error handling, virtual environments, and common libraries (e.g., pandas, openpyxl, requests)
Basic PowerShell scripting skills for Windows and Microsoft 365 automation
Understanding of version control with Git, including branching, commits, and pull requests
Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and working with data in Excel, CSV, and SQL databases
Basic understanding of AI and large language model concepts, their limitations, and responsible use with company and client data
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to break a manual process into automatable steps
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical topics to engineers and non-technical staff
Attention to detail and a commitment to testing, documentation, and code quality
Ability to manage multiple tasks, take direction and feedback, and work both independently and as part of a team
Preferred
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field preferred
Associate's degree combined with a strong portfolio of Python or automation projects (e.g., GitHub repositories, internship work, or class projects) will be considered
Microsoft certifications in Power Platform, Azure, or Azure AI (fundamentals or associate level) are a plus
Agile or Scrum certification (e.g., PSM I, CSM) is a plus
Exposure to no-code/low-code automation platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, or comparable tools preferred
Experience with Azure DevOps (Repos, Boards, Pipelines) or a comparable Git-based development platform preferred
Exposure to Autodesk Revit—including the Revit API, Dynamo, or pyRevit—preferred
Experience working on a team using Agile development practices (Scrum or Kanban) preferred
Experience using or integrating AI tools, large language model APIs, or prompt engineering is a plus
Experience or coursework in the AEC, MEP, or professional engineering services industry is a plus
Interest in learning MEP engineering concepts (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire protection) and BIM workflows
